title: Resilient forest universality in percolated dense graphs
summary: Christoph, Müyesser and Wigderson recently asked whether an approximate form of the Erdős-Sós conjecture is robust under random edge deletions. We establish a density-sensitive transference theorem that converts global resilience for bounded-degree trees in sparse random graphs into resilient forest universality in arbitrary dense host graphs.
